title: SceneAxi free-vs-paid entitlement matrix (v1)
description: The one canonical capability pricing table. A product boundary, so it is a closed enumeration rather than a lookup with a default: an unknown capability refuses, and there is no path where forgetting to register something makes it free. accountRequired false means the capability must work with no account at all — the free path (engine SDK download, CLI and local agent authoring, bring-your-own AI keys) is a product guarantee, and bring-your-own keys never burn SceneAxi credits. Mirrors packages/schemas/src/entitlements.ts ENTITLEMENT_MATRIX; pnpm check:contracts keeps the docs/auth-credits.md table in exact lockstep with this file, and a seam test asserts the TypeScript table and this fixture are identical. Deliberately expressed in the JSON Schema subset scripts/check-contracts.mjs supports.

starterCreditGrant.description: Credits every new user receives exactly once, under idempotency key starter:<userId>.

capabilities.description: The eight exact v1 capability rules in canonical order. No other capability, account rule, price rule, duplicate, omission, or reordering is valid.
